items.requirement: Authentication is required for protected API routes.

items.requirement: Each logical event has a stable idempotency key.
The same key cannot create multiple external documents.
Database uniqueness constraints enforce deduplication.
Retries reuse the original key.
Duplicate callbacks do not repeat state changes or notifications.
Callback processing is safe if the same logical result arrives again.
HMAC-SHA256 signing matches the documented canonical message format.
Method, path, timestamp, nonce, and body hash are included consistently.
Invalid signatures are rejected.
Expired or excessively skewed timestamps are rejected.
Reused nonces are rejected.
Unknown key IDs are rejected.
Signature comparison uses a constant-time comparison.
items.evidence: [app/integrations/signing.py](app/integrations/signing.py) uses hmac.compare_digest; signature rejection/tampering tests execute that verifier.

items.requirement: Callback authorization is independent of frontend roles.

items.requirement: A valid signed gateway request is accepted.
An invalid signature is rejected.
An expired timestamp is rejected.
A reused nonce is rejected.
Repeating a document request with the same idempotency key creates only one document.
Manager approval succeeds while the gateway is offline.
The outbox event remains pending and retries after recovery.
Exhausted retries become DEAD and are visible to HR.
A valid callback updates the external reference and integration status.
Repeated callback processing does not duplicate notifications.
Employee tokens cannot invoke privileged callbacks or manager/HR operations.
Profile and last-known HR snapshot remain available while the gateway is down.
A manager cannot approve requests outside their authorized scope.
A failed transaction leaves no partial approval/outbox state.
Course progress persists after reload.
AI Jana returns a source-backed answer or a safe fallback.
